primary_endpoint: Reduction in hepatic fat and stiffness measured by FibroScan, and changes in serum hepatic enzymes and CK-18 levels over 6 months.
efficacy_outcome: Neither chlorogenic acid nor caffeine was superior to placebo for hepatic fat, stiffness, or other hepatic outcomes. Compared with placebo, total cholesterol was lower with caffeine (p=0.04), and insulin was higher with chlorogenic acid plus caffeine (p=0.01); other between-group differences were not significant.
